end.summary:
Identified soil animals including earthworms and beetles.
Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water enter soil.
Connected tunnels with faster water movement into soil.
The lesson also covered soil animals turning dead leaves into rich soil; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the role of soil animals through examples and a tunnel analogy. Pihu correctly connected earthworm tunnels with air and water entering the soil, and this idea was reinforced later in the lesson. The dead-leaf-to-rich-soil part still needs another short review. At home, ask Pihu to explain both jobs using a simple drawing of an earthworm tunnel and fallen leaves.
